verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents object cloning, including database- and schema-level clones that carry their own privilege grants, and a user praises its "cloning" feature. This implies you can spin up a separate copy of production objects to test against, but the evidence never states that clones are isolated from the source or meant as sandbox or dev environments. missing for 10: explicit documentation that clones are isolated from production data, documented sandbox/dev-environment or zero-copy test workflows, agent-oriented sandbox guidance, hands-on corroboration of safe testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: If the source object is a database or schema, the clone inherits all granted privileges on the clones of all child objects contained in the source object
definitely has some nice features (cloning, storage integrations, etc).
